## Main Projects

### A01 Garden Party Pinball
Status: active build
Label: pinball machine build
A full-size homebrew pinball machine in progress using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and playfield revisions.
Evidence: FAST Pinball boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils / switches / lamps, CAD + wiring revisions
Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders
To document next: photos, playfield CAD, wiring maps, MPF configs, driver tests, rule notes

### A02 VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm
Status: Stanford AI4ALL team project
Label: team robotics simulation
Source: https://github.com/LenekyRadish/VividGrasp
My role: Head CAD designer, prepared URDF files, worked with a teammate to create a physical prototype.
Related program/logo link: https://ai4all.spcs.stanford.edu/
Stanford AI4ALL project built by a team of 10 students. It connects SolidWorks CAD, STL mesh export, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target-based vision/control input, and robotic arm joint motion.
Evidence: Stanford AI4ALL, team of 10, SolidWorks CAD, URDF / PyBullet simulation, target-based control, simulated arm motion
Media: 4 slots, 4 live, 0 placeholders
To document next: personal role notes, vision/control details, CAD export notes, simulation setup notes

### A03 Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB
Status: prototype needs documentation
Label: plant-watering prototype
A plant-watering prototype with moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, and enclosure/PCB work. It still needs updated photos, schematics, and test notes.
Evidence: ESP32 / Arduino-style control, pump driver, sensor input, KiCad + enclosure planning
Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders
To document next: updated photos, schematic, board outline, enclosure constraints, connector plan, watering state machine

### A04 Subpix
Status: V1 software project
Label: functional desktop app
Project: https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix
My role: Built the editor, file format flow, export path, product site, and Windows packaging.
Open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript desktop app for editing .subpix files, validating JSON load/save data, exporting PNGs, and packaging for Windows.
Evidence: Electron, Vite / React / TypeScript, .subpix editing, JSON validation, PNG export, Windows packaging
Media: 2 slots, 1 live, 1 placeholder
To document next: editor screenshots, export demo, Windows installer notes, example .subpix files

## Full Record

### Main builds

- Garden Party Pinball - full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST hardware, MPF, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and playfield revisions.
- VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm - Stanford AI4ALL project built by a team of 10, connecting SolidWorks CAD, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target-based vision/control input, and robotic arm joint motion.
- Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB - moisture sensing, pump control, enclosure planning, and a custom PCB direction.
- Subpix - open-source Electron/Vite/React/TypeScript desktop editor for .subpix files, RGB/BGR subpixel canvas editing, JSON validation, PNG export, and Windows installer packaging.

### Software, visualization, and AI

- Check-ins - live Vercel app for logging consistency and tracking target/max gaps.
- Desmos 3D Solar System - 3D math visualization using surfaces, orbits, color mapping, and performance-aware scene design.
- TinyGPT Experiments - small language-model project focused on next-token prediction and instruction-following differences.
- MIDI Practice Tool - Python music-practice utility for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard-style interaction.
- Manim / presentation animation work - timed explanation visuals for presentations.
- BetterQuizzer / quiz-app work - quiz-app development and debugging for hosted submission and persistence behavior.

### Fabrication and maker skills

- Home maker-lab practice - CAD, wiring, printing, scanning, electronics, and mechanical assembly.
- VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype - robotics drivetrain build using gearing and packaging constraints around structure interference.
- SolidWorks modeling - part design, assemblies, complex forms, and fabrication-oriented CAD decisions.
